articleTitle: Bus arrival time prediction model based on APC data
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Bus arrival times are influenced by stochastic variations in number of factors, (e.g., intersection delays, traffic congestion, and weather conditions) resulting in buses to deviate from the predetermined schedule and lengthening of passenger waiting times for buses. Providing passengers with accurate bus arrival times through advanced traveler information systems can help passengers' decision making and reduce average waiting time for buses. In this paper, a set of models, predicting bus arrival times at stops along a route, are developed through mining historical data collected by automated passenger counters (APC). The data applied for developing the models were collected by APC installed on buses operated by the public transit agency in Harbin, a city of northeast region of China. The results obtained are promising, and indicate that the developed models can be used to estimate bus arrival times.

articleTitle: The optimum selection of medium and long-term terminal area planning based on interval TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: The optimum selection of medium and long-term terminal area planning is very important to the work quality and efficiency of air traffic management and flight safety. However, in practice, the optimum selection is usually made by some professional experts based on their specialized domain knowledge and experience. This human-made selection can be biased or not favourable. To solve this problem, we present an evaluation method based on the interval TOPSIS technique. Our method can make unbiased optimum selection without human interference. We give details of this new method in this paper, including constructing evaluation indicator system, obtaining values of each indicator, building evaluation model based on interval TOPSIS, and finding solution to the model, etc. In the last part of this paper, we present a numerical example to demonstrate the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Simulation algorithm for multi-train movement with Fixed Automatic-Block System
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of the trains under Fixed Automatic Block System in detail. Based on the model of the single train, the model of multi-train operation with precise train dynamic calculation is founded. The model can clearly describe the running state of the proceeding train and the impact of the signal change on the following train's control strategy. New algorithm is discussed about how to determine the control modes and handles through considering dynamic variation of signal aspect and corresponding speed limits. At last, it gives some simulation results to show that the simulation methods of the multi-train operation can efficiently reflect the moving interference between successive trains and singling system.

articleTitle: Road traffic performance monitoring in Beijing
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: In Beijing, with the rapid growth of motor vehicles, the contradiction between traffic demand and supply becomes more and more serious. Many travel demand measure (TDM) policies have been researched and implemented. The most important measures are "odd-even vehicle ban" during the 2008 Olympics and "vehicle ban one day a week" after the Olympics. Because the traditional traffic flow parameter such as speed, volume or density cannot give a comprehensive and traceable description of the road traffic congestion, a set of urban road traffic performance indices have been put forward. Five comprehensive indices are used to describe traffic congestion from the aspects of intensity, extension, duration, frequency, and reliability respectively. Based on abundant ITS data inputs, Beijing intelligent transportation analysis platform (BTAP) is designed and developed, by which the overall road traffic performance of Beijing especially the urban area with the fifth ring road can be monitored in real-time. The platform plays an important role in transportation policies making, transportation planning and management. Furthermore, the effects of TDM policies have been monitored by the platform. In this paper, the definition and calculation method of road traffic performance indices are introduced, and then the road traffic performance under TDM policies are analyzed comparatively. It is shown that the whole set of indices and methodology are scientific and practical, which explores a new way to monitoring the traffic performance and congestion evaluation in real-time based on ITS data.

articleTitle: Passenger transportation system of central city-satellite city
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: It is important to strengthen the passenger transportation connection between satellite city and central city, which can develop the satellite city economy and alleviate traffic and the land use pressure in the central city. It is also important to analyze the passenger transportation system between satellite city and central city and establish a reasonable passenger model to solve the two-city transport links. There are many kinds of passenger transportation modes that can be chosen between central city and satellite city. There are many factors that should be considered, for example, safety, economy, efficiency and convenience. It is a complex system problem. Because a reasonable passenger information model shows the characteristics of grey, it is difficult to use ordinary methods to select the best model. This paper analyzes the relations between various key elements within the comprehensive passenger traffic system with game theory, proposes comprehensive passenger traffic system game theory model hierarchically, and then carries on reasonable passenger traffic decision using grey system theory. Finally an example proves the method is feasible.

articleTitle: Influence of transit connecting with central cities to land-use in satellite cities
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: The concept of reasonable floor area ratio (FAR) based on transit-oriented development (TOD) was put forward. The model which explores the influence of different transit modes between a central city and a satellite city to FAR in reasonable-walking area around the station in the satellite city was set up. It shows the reasonable FAR of walking area in a satellite city is in direct proportion to the capacity of the transit between the satellite city and the center city. The example indicates that the different modes of the transit between the central city and the satellite city (TCCSC) have the different land-use density, the function of the subway and suburb rail in raising the land-use density of a satellite city is obvious.

articleTitle: Transportation infrastructure, industrial spillover effect and economic growth
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: This paper establishes a two-sector model for analyzing the interrelation between transportation infrastructure expansions and remaining industry production growth in terms of the idea of Feder (1983). Transportation infrastructure sector is supposed to generate a spillover effect on the other sectors. The equation is estimated for 30 provinces in China from 1990 to 2007. This paper finds that the spillover effect would drive the economy to grow approximately 0.45 percent when given the 10 percent growth of transportation infrastructure sector. Besides, the spillover effect on the non-transportation infrastructure sector ranges from 0.441 to 0.931, which is comparatively large. Conclusion can be made that the spillover effect on the remaining sectors is very significant and the economy is influenced by the effect to some extent. It is a great issue to make full use of this spillover effect to help economic development. After the 4 trillion infrastructure investment plan of Chinese government, an important issue regarding transportation infrastructure is how efficiently the government manages the existing capital stocks.

articleTitle: Fractal characteristics of the road network in Jiangsu province
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Based on fractal theory, and with the help of GIS software, this paper illustrates our research on the spatial structures and patterns of the road network in both northern and southern Jiangsu province at the year of 1999 and 2009. Hausdorff dimension value and covering depth of the road network have been calculated in both the two regions at the year of 1999 and 2009. The evolution of road networks in Jiangsu Province over the last decade has also been analyzed. The results show that in the same year, no significant differences exist in the fractal dimension and covering depth between the two regions, but for the same region, the difference between the year of 1999 and 2009 is remarkable, which indicates a rapid construction and development of the road network in Jiangsu province over the last decade, and a well maintained regional balance at the same time.

articleTitle: Integrated transportation hub (ITH) organization management and methodology models
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Application of Intelligent transportation system in integrated transportation hub management has got much progress. It makes people much rely on traffic, logistic information service. This paper first introduces a design of function of integrated transportation hub information management (ITHIM), multi traffic enterprises negotiating-cooperation problems in (ITHIM) platform and the role of discipline knowledge science and systems science in enterprises, service agent and transport-related branch as well. Then, after the discussion on current trend in systems science, the paper proposes systems methodology for knowledge management and creation in traffic organization management of ITHM. Finally, the paper discusses mathematical modeling techniques to represent organization negotiation and human knowledge management.

articleTitle: Complexity analysis of railway passenger transport service network
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: With the development of complex science, the complex network theory has been widely used in the field of transport system. The current paper statistically analyzed the China railway passenger transport service network using the complex network theory. Several important factors are concerned: the degree distribution of nodes, average path length, and clustering coefficient. The results indicate that a power-law distribution curve is used to fit the RPTSN (railway passenger transport service network). Regarding the shortest path length, there are average 4 or 5 stop sites from one stop site to other stop site. The results of the static indicators prove that the RPTSN is a scale-free network.

articleTitle: Regional road network optimization based on state analysis
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: A regional traffic control optimization is a problem of finding the optimal design parameters while we take into account the route choice of users. This problem can be formulated as a bi-level programming program by taking the user equilibrium traffic assignment as a constraint. To enhance effectiveness of signal control, state differences between road flows is distilled to build a traffic state hierarchical model. Then this model is inducted to bi level model, in which signal control scheme and user equilibrium traffic assignment are optimized in the upper and lower level respectively. Genetic algorithm is applied to resolve the upper level while optimal value of the lower level is worked out by classical Frank-Wolf method. The solution procedure developed with the genetic algorithm has-been tested as an example of factual road network. Extensive experimental analysis in comparison with results from former control methods reveal that the proposed model is quite promising for use in design of regional signal control.

articleTitle: Founding low-carbon highway freight transportation networks: An example study on Shandong province
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: The transport industry of China is facing a hard on how to reduce carbon dioxide emissions at the same time as transports is increasing. We have focused here on the solution that is most feasible for short-term implementation: founding low-carbon freight transportation networks by developing semi-trailer swap transportation. The study is carried out in two aspects: First, in order to reduce carbon dioxide emissions at the same time as the freight transportation volume is increasing, promoting the transport efficiency by reconfiguring transportation network is attainable. It's essential to analyze exactly the spatial distribution of transportation demand so as to replan the transportation networks effectively. Theoretically qualitative analysis and empirical works on Shandong province are carried out to find the relationship between industry and highway freight transportation. Secondly, since semi trailer swap transportation mode has some technical and economic advantages which accord with easing climate and environmental issues, semi-trailer swap transportation networks are employed to found a low carbon freight transportation system. A presumedly configuration of the network is shown based on the empirical works on Shandong province.

articleTitle: Comparison study of the development of ethanol fuels in China
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the producing principles of ethanol fuels for the vehicles and their development in the world,in the article the ethanol fuels is compared with conventional fuels in eight indicators covering economic, environment and producing technology by AHP model. The main objective of this research work is to study the difficulties and arising obstacles of promoting the ethanol fuel in Chinese market based on the calculation results, and finally propose appropriate solutions and new ideas to ease the energy crisis and traffic pollutions in China.

articleTitle: Effect analysis on railway productivity distribution adjustment to freight forwarding time
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: In order to analyze the effects of railway productivity distribution adjustment on the timeliness of freight forwarding, on the basis of investigation and present achievement, the railway freight forwarding process and the change of each factor which affects freight forwarding time under the condition of railway productivity distribution adjustment are analyzed. The average speed of each kind of freight train including non through train, ordinary through train and fast freight train, as well as daily average running time of heavy train is analyzed, and the statistical results are examined by adopting χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> testing method, from which daily average running tariff kilometre is obtained. Finally , daily average running tariff kilometre before and after railway productivity distribution adjustment is compared. The analytical results show that through the adjustment of railway productivity distribution, the operating taches of railway freight forwarding gradually reduce, and the primary parameters influencing θ all have changes to different degree, and the timeliness of railway freight forwarding improves constantly.

articleTitle: Travel time estimation based on intelligent vehicle infrastructure cooperation system
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: The paper proposed a travel time estimation (TTE) method based on the intelligent vehicle infrastructure cooperation system (IVICS), a new generation of intelligent transportation system (ITS) based on inter vehicle and road-vehicle communication, utilizing the vehicle information gathered by vehicles which equipped with communication module in IVICS. A simulation platform of IVICS was set up using the traffic simulation software Paramics, database software MySQL and mathematical software MALAB. The TTE method was applied and validated on the platform and good results were achieved. The proposed TTE method was also validated with the NGSIM data and precise estimation were achieved: The MAPE can reach to approximately 7% when the equipped proportion is 0.2 and time interval of information collecting is 30 s. The influence of equipped proportion and time granularity is considered and the conclusion is that when equipped proportion increased or time granularity decreased, the accuracy of the estimation can be improved, but at the same time, the cost increased.

articleTitle: Study and application of distribution ratios model of passenger flows in city group inter-city transportation structure configuration
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Based on the analysis of passengers' whole travel process and choice characteristics of transportation mode, this article studies the factors of distribution ratios of passenger flows in inter-city transportation corridor. From the point of inter-city traffic integration and the entire travel chain, we introduce generalized cost function, and improve traditional multi-dimensional Logit model, to establish intermediate-short distance, multi-mode, and large capacity rational distribution ratios model of passenger flows on inter-city transportation corridor, which uses maximum likelihood method to calibrate the parameters of the model. From the point of whole effectiveness optimization and integration of transport modes' convergence, it analyzes the relationship between transportation convergence and transfer in the transportation corridor. Finally, a case analysis is made to be combined with Guangzhou Qingyuan inter-city transportation corridor, and verifies the established passenger flow distribution ratios model's feasibility, and predicts the changes of distribution ratios after the completion of inter-city rail transit in the future.

articleTitle: Model and algorithm for multimodal transport network equilibrium based on hierarchical property
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Utilizing transport multiple modes and hierarchical property, integrated regional transport network is studied from a systematical and quantitative way. After generalized route cost function defined by hierarchical property and fine concept of transport mode split, Logit Stochastic equilibrium model of multilevel multimode integrated transport network is proposed under the condition of elastic demand and link capacity constraints. The equivalent variational inequality of the equilibrium model is formulated and proved by variational inequality theory and optimization theory. Furthermore, after a hierarchical equilibrium condition defined in the light of Wardrop equilibrium principle, the equivalent variational inequality of deterministic equilibrium problem is established with the hierarchical equilibrium condition and nonlinear complementarity problem. Simple solution approach to augmented Lagrange dual algorithm is finally designed for multilevel multimodal deterministic equilibrium problem with fixed demand.

articleTitle: Analysis and application of automated data collection system in subway
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Automatic data collection (ADC) systems are becoming increasingly common in transit systems throughout the world. Although these ADC systems are often designed to support specific fairly narrow functions, the resulting data can have wide-ranging application, well beyond their design purpose. Relative to traditional manual survey, transportation planners only need to dig existed database to get both real-time and long term information using automated collection data. This paper studied the applications of data mining technique in the information processing of automated data collection systems in subway, and put forward a framework for data mining system. The author studied on the analysis method in subway passenger flow and travel information, based on current technology in the subway data collection. Using data mining techniques and statistical analysis, the subway OD matrix and capacity rate is derived from collection data, travel time distribution of passengers was carried out a detailed description, and it is of important significance in scheduling and management of metro systems.

articleTitle: Network coupling of urban land use and public transport
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: The interaction between travel demand and land use is one of the focus of urban and region sustainable transport development. For the rapidly expanding urbanization, the effective organization of urban land use and travel demand is a priority approach. It is very significant to explore the network coupling relationship between travel demand and land use for understanding and mastering the laws of interaction between urban transport networks, development of scientific urban and regional comprehensive transport development strategy. In this paper, the transportation network characteristics are analysed at first, and then the network coupling analysis method on urban transport network (including the public transport network and road networks) and urban land use is built. What is done above is to open out the interaction law between urban land use and travel demand on the network. The research results show that the spatial analysis method can be a very good approach for evaluating the relationship among bus stops, bus routes, job density and population density. In conjunction with urban cases, the focus of land use layout and public transport development is also reveals.

articleTitle: A comprehensive evaluation method of adding passenger stations in existing intercity railway line
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Adding stations in existing intercity railway line is one of new research fields on passenger station location selection. In reference to the multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) of location selection evaluation of existing intercity railway passenger station, firstly it determines the number of stops that needs to be added by passengers investigation; secondly, five indexes such as local economic development degree and layout coordination degree between alternative and existing stations are established; thirdly, in order to evaluate the alternatives conveniently by experts and express experts' evaluation information well and truly, triangular fuzzy number is introduced in this research. TOPSIS is introduced into this paper after an Euclidean distance method was proposed to calculate the distance between two triangular fuzzy numbers. According to the concept of TOPSIS, a closeness coefficient is defined to determine the ranking order of all alternatives by calculating the distances to both the fuzzy positive-ideal solution and fuzzy negative-ideal solution simultaneously. Finally, the order of alternatives is achieved in light of closeness coefficient, and the new stations are selected according to the order. This method has provided the scientific foundation for the decision-making in the location selection of passenger station along existing intercity railway line.

articleTitle: Applications of automated monitoring system in road passenger transportation
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Speeding, fatigue driving and overloading can lead to some major road traffic accidents, and are difficulties of safety management on road passenger transportation. Effective and efficient real-time monitoring is the key to prevention of passenger vehicles speeding, fatigue driving and overloading, and to improving the results of safety management. This paper will introduce the design, implementation and result of automated monitoring system developed by Yunfa Corp., with detailed explanation on methods and tools of monitoring speeding, fatigue driving and overloading. In addition, the paper will also introduce the passenger counting system using surveillance camera, and analyze the algorithm as well as application results.

articleTitle: Relationship between transportation and land use based on data of mobile communication
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Within the past decades although massive amounts of money and human resources have been put to solve the traffic congestion problem through the world, road congestion still a persistent major factor which has a strong effect on daily life. How to get useful traffic information is a big problem, in the past, such as loop detects, video surveillance is a good idea. Cell phone information is available directly from the mobile carriers, requiring less installation cost and labour work compared to other methods such as conventional loop-detectors and resident surveys.

articleTitle: Efficiency assessment of transport infrastructure investment within a CGE framework
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: This paper describes two different mechanisms based on the process of infrastructure construction to analyze the economic effects of transport infrastructure investment. To examine the effects and the investment efficiency, a single-country, static Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) framework for China is established. Two simulations are carried out by using a China 2002 Social Accounting Matrix (SAM) in the simulation part. Our main conclusion is that the transportation infrastructure investment promotes the economic development dramatically only in the indirect stage; the development of the economy also gives the positive feedback to the further derived demand of transportation investment. It is clear that all these won't happen without the carrier of labor which can spread the economic effects of transportation to different sectors through indirect mechanism and finally promote the long-term development of the wider economy.

articleTitle: Left-turn prohibition measures warrants at unsignalized intersections
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: In order to set left-turn prohibition measures rationally, left-turn prohibition measures installation warrants at unsignalized intersection are discussed. While the analyses on conflict characteristics generation mechanism and different detour types of left-turn traffic are also described in this paper. We define conflict points as the sum of the two convergent traffic volume and establish intersection conflict points calculation model before and after taking left-turn prohibition measures. Then the conflict points variation value is taken as left-turn prohibition evaluation standard. If the variation value decreases after setting left-turn prohibition measures, we believe the measure is feasible; Otherwise, it is not suitable. Then an example is presented as verification which showing good results. The research will provide a basis for the implementation of left-turn prohibition measures at unsignalized intersections and improve its traffic efficiency.

articleTitle: Problems of shield tunneling for Beijing metro and solutions
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Based on a detailed investigation and analysis, the present situation of shield tunneling for Beijing metro construction was studied. The main problems of shield method in the planning of the projects were as follows. First, continuous tunnel sections constructed by shield method were only a few; second, the efficiency of shield machine was low; third, the time used for non-driving tasks in shield tunneling was too long; fourth, the construction period using shield tunneling could not be guaranteed; and finally, the additional cost of shield tunneling was high. Detailed analysis indicates that the major cause for the problems was the contradiction of construction time between shield tunnel sections and adjoining stations, with the additional cause being that construction organization of shield tunneling was not well planned, that is the problem of shield machine passing the station was not well solved. A solution to the problems was put forward: let the shield machine pass a series of stations in the line first, and then construct the stations by cut-and-cover method or mining method at proper times. Such scheme shows great advantages in improving the quality, increasing the speed and reducing the cost of metro construction.

articleTitle: Analysis and forecast of transportation development on three intercity corridors in China
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta and the Pearl River Delta are China's three City Concentrated Areas, or CCAs, whose intercity transportation demands are also the greatest. To meet the great intercity transportation demands, many expressways, high-speed railways and intercity railways are being constructed or planned on the major corridors such as Beijing-Tianjin, Shanghai-Nanjing and Guangzhou-Shenzhen, etc. This paper studies three intercity corridors' transportation characteristics, analyses the planning and technical-economic advantages of expressway and railway, forecasts the passenger and freight volumes in the future, and also gives proposals for intercity transport development on intercity corridors.

articleTitle: Estimating critical gap of roundabouts by different methods
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Critical gap is an important parameter which affects the capacity and delay of unsignalized intersections. There are different critical gap values for drivers in different geometry parameters and traffic conditions. Critical gap is generally considered to follow Erlang distribution, lognormal distribution, etc. Various methods calculating critical gap of roundabouts have been presented. Many studies on gap acceptance at roundabouts have been carried out in America, Australia and some countries in Europe; whereas the same works have rarely been done in China. This paper gives an overview of many methods calculating critical gap. On the base of video survey of Shuma Square roundabout in Dalian, we acquired a large number of rejected gaps and accepted gaps in rush hour. Critical gap can be calculated by use of different methods including Ashworth's method, Raff's method and the maximum likelihood method (MLM). As a result, the maximum likelihood method and the revised Raffs method can be recommended for practical application, and Ashworth's method will result in larger result because it only uses values of accepted gap.

articleTitle: Setting position of bus station on expressway
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: In view of the current situation that some cities choose to operate bus and BRT on urban expressway while lacking theoretical guidance, this paper studies the setting position of bus station on expressway. First, the operating and functional characteristics of bus station on expressway are analyzed. As a result, the paper puts forward two basic requirements for bus station position setting on expressway: to ensure smooth-running of expressway, and convenient transfer with buses on relief road. The study on the position setting of bus station to ensure smooth running of expressway is converted into study on the minimum distance between bus station and entrance/exit. The mechanism of mutual effects between the two is resolved. And based on kinematics theory, traffic flow theory and probability theory the calculation models of minimum distance are established, using Monte Carlo methods for solving models. In the study of position setting of bus stations to ensure convenient passenger transfer, the paper points out that bus station on expressway should be set near bus station on relief road, and relating facilities should be built to make passenger transfer convenient and safe. Six typical design patterns of transfer are concluded. This paper can guide urban expressway traffic design directly and is also helpful to expressway BRT design.

articleTitle: Coordinated ramp metering on expressway with congestion
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: In order to solve the traffic congestion control problem on expressway, the influencing areas in the upstream of the congestion section and a kind of heuristic coordinated ramp metering methods are focused on. According to the mechanism that traffic flow moves to the upstream of the section in the congestion duration time, queue length is considered as the significant factor in the determination of congestion influencing areas. The formula is deduced to calculate the number of ramps in the influencing areas. Due to the low adjusting speed in the single point level and wide vibration amplitude in the coordination level in the traditional methods, the density is selected as the control parameter instead of the traffic flow volume in the Bottleneck algorithm. Meanwhile, the improved on ramp coordination metering method and the adjustment rate formula are formed based on Bottleneck algorithm eliminating the limitations of traditional methods. Taken the road section from Gongyi to Luoyang on the Lianhuo expressway as the instance, coordinated ramp metering simulation analysis is conducted by using the MATLAB software. The rationality and effectiveness of the formula of calculating the number of ramps in the congestion influencing areas and the improved algorithm are demonstrated by means of the numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation model for port shorelines resources under low-carbon responsibility
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: By analyzing the port status and problems of shorelines resources in China, combining with the requirements of sustainable development of shorelines resources, and based on niche theory, the paper establishes an optimal allocation model of shorelines resources to solve the optimal allocation of resources coastline by quantitative economic ecology, natural ecology and social ecology. Meanwhile, it pulls in a virtual port coastline data to simulate optimization steps to go a step further. This paper studies the low carbon niche under the responsibility of shorelines resources based on optimization model and provides a basis for further study in the future.

articleTitle: Ecological adaptability evaluation for urban passenger traffic structure
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: The analysis and evaluation of urban passenger traffic structure (UPTS) is necessary for achieving urban traffic development decision scientifically and improving urban traffic system efficiency. After analyzing the characteristics of various traffic modes, a general ecological adaptability evaluation (EAE) model for UPTS was proposed. This model mainly referred to three aspects, for instance, vehicle trip volume, energy consumption, and environment. Specifically, ecological index (EI) was calculated by traffic structure index and ecological cost index. Moreover, a criterion of EI was given according to the national "11th five-year" plan of economy and social development. Finally, the EI value of Harbin's UPTS was calculated according to the collected data between 2000 and 2009. It showed that most UPTS of big cites in China were in the non-ecological development state in past.

articleTitle: Passengers' perception based public transportation service quality evaluating methodology
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Public transportation system make a good sense to reduce the emission of Carbon Dioxide, and this study proposes a revised SERVQUAL-based method to evaluate urban bus service quality from passengers' point of view, which aimed to increase the ridership share by increasing the quality of this service. Two representative bus routes, Bei'an and Line 119, selected from Shanghai and Chengdu respectively are investigated. Data used to reflect passengers' expectation of public transportation service and their real perception are collected via questionnaire. The results show that waiting time and vehicle capacity are two major characteristics that passengers are most concerned and sensitive to, and passengers of Bei'an Line suffer more from ticket fare while what plagues their counterparts of Line 119 is the inconvenience of transfer with other public transport service systems.

articleTitle: Signal control and simulation of a typical roundabout
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Signal control plays an importing role on resolving traffic jam on big roundabout. This paper analyzes signal control methods and characteristics on roundabout home and abroad. The characteristics of signal control and non-signal control on the roundabout were analyzed by comparison. Further more, it was introduced to discuss signal control methods on roundabout, emphasize the principle, steps and designing parameters of turning-left two-step signal control method (TTSM) and so on. Finally, it was illuminated through a typical roundabout operation control of Harbin Hongbo intersection. From analysis on delays and level of services (LOS) with Vissim software before and after, it showed that TTSM was an effective method to roundabout control, especially for the roundabout with saturated flow of turning left. It efficiently dealt with traffic jam on roundabout.

Author Keywords: turning -left and two-step signal control method

articleTitle: Discrete Modal Choice Model in suburban districts
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of Discrete Modal Choice Model is developed as an Multinomial Logit Model. In this model the RP (revealed preference) and VOT of SP (state preference) surveys are used to calibrate the significance of a multinomial Logit model, and a survey and analysis of Shunyi district, one of new urban area of Beijing, which located in north of Beijing, is introduced as a case study. First, cross-tables analysis method was used to select four class variables from seven as the significant. Then a multinomial Logit module of SPSS is given as the model result with and without VOT per trips variable. Further, the accuracy of the model with VOT per trips is better then the other models are founded. From the result, the conclusion is given, that there are advantages to jointly estimating the models with RP and SP surveys.

articleTitle: Performance analysis on private vehicle plate auction in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Since 1986, the private vehicle plate auction (PVPA) in Shanghai has gradually turned into one of the effective regulation measures to eliminate total amount of private vehicles. Rooted from the public economics and governmental regulation theories, this paper presents three main reasons-irrational travel decision-making, excess car demand and social inequality on road right- why private vehicles need to be regulated by plate auction, and takes the PVPA as one of the vehicle quota regulation measures among marketing tools. After qualitatively analyzing the social benefit and cost of PVPA, this paper emphasizes on stakeholder analysis which demonstrates respective preference and choice between Shanghai and ecdemic plates of different groups. The performance of this policy relies on the difference between the increasing vehicles with ecdemic plates and the decrease of potential vehicle buyers who abandon purchase due to expensive auction price of Shanghai plates. Finally in a "with-and-without" policy scenario, a quantitative prediction has been conducted, revealing the fact that till 2008 around 830 thousand to 2.73 million vehicles have been totally eliminated by PVPA policy according to different elasticity of vehicle development to income.

articleTitle: Extraction of traffic status based on spatial-temporal trajectory reconstruction
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Intelligent transportation system (ITS) is recognized as an important means to solve traffic problems. The most crucial way to implement ITS is real time traffic control and dynamic traffic guidance, which are all based on the acquisition of traffic status timely and accurately. This paper puts forward a prototype system of IVICS (integration of vehicle infrastructure cooperation system), which completely changes traditional traffic information collection method. In IVICS, equipped vehicles can be regarded as moving sensors on road network, which can collect local traffic parameters distributedly and transmit to road-side station. This paper also proposes traffic status extraction method, by interpolation of incomplete trajectory data of equipped vehicles, we can reconstruct spacial-temporal trajectories to estimate traffic density, average speed and travel time of certain road segment. Simulations of NGSIM dataset show that even equipped rate is very low, such method can get precise estimation of traffic status, which demonstrates the effectiveness of the above algorithm.

articleTitle: Low carbon transportation in Japan and its developmental analysis
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Summary form only given. The acceleration of urbanization results more and more people living in cities, in turn, the rapid growth of logistics, population and traffic flow come along, which causes a series of transportation and environment problems such as the increases of traffic congestion and exhaust emission, etc. This article, focus on the following four aspects, systematically studied the developmental model of low-carbon transportation in Japan in terms of the current status of transportation carbon emission, the structure of metropolitan transportation system, and policy execution, etc. in process of transition to low carbon society. This study will provide valuable information to China in the area of developing low-carbon transportation system.

articleTitle: City logistics transportation invisible cost control based on ITS
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Intelligent transport system is the primary measure to improve efficiency and security of transportation. In modern logistics system, the use of ITS technology will increase the efficiency, benefits and security of logistics system. This article analyses the reasons of transport invisible cost in the city logistics system, and points out emphatically the influence of the city traffic problems for the transportation invisible cost, and proposes reasonable transport policy based on ITS, and builds on intelligent transport systems-transport management system (ITS-TMS). Finally, the control technology of the city logistics transport invisible costs based on ITS is put forward.

articleTitle: Behavior of pedestrians compressing vehicle lanes at intersections
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Pedestrians will conflict with the turn-right or clearance vehicles when crossing an intersection, resulting in the behavior of pedestrians compressing motor vehicle lanes. By video survey of this phenomenon, we found that the signal timing, pedestrians' forward inclination, pedestrians' psychological factors, interference among motor vehicles and pedestrians' waiting zones were occupied were the reasons of behavior. Several measures are presented to solve this problem, including assign proper signal time, ensure area of pedestrians' waiting zones, and promote visual appreciation around the intersection, perfect traffic facilities within the intersection and the guidance of an effective transport strategy. The study describes the behavior of cross intersection pedestrians from a new point of view, gives several approaches to the effective management of intersections, provides a valid way to ensure the safety of pedestrians and maintain the traffic order at intersections.

articleTitle: Factors contributing to urban expressway entrance and exit safety
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: In order to obtain the relationship between traffic safety and influencing factors such as entrance and exit design and facilities setting, this paper uses number of traffic conflicts to measure traffic safety, determines experimental factors, designs experimental method, and establishes simulation models based on SSAM with calibrated parameters to collect traffic conflict data under a series of experimental factors of different levels. The result includes: traffic conflicts at exit are more than that at entrance; the gradient of ramp has some but not apparent effect on traffic conflicts; lane change and deceleration in advance is most important for improving traffic safety, and is the most effective method to decrease number of traffic conflicts. The tendency the result shows is in accordance with previous accident data and qualitative analysis, and thus credible. Finally, the paper puts forward principles for expressway design and safety facilities setting.

articleTitle: Area traffic planning based on evaluation index systems and public sectors performance—Case study of China
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: This paper has studied problems of area traffic plans, analyzed guiding and limitation that the party (CCP) and government leader group and leading cadre indicators for performance appraisal plan to area traffic instantly, and given content preference-based index out analysis method. Structure builds out relationship local communications department plan business indicators for performance appraisal system. Traffic business indicators for performance appraisal system include 10 major kinds of one-level index, and 27 is similar to two stage indicators for performance appraisal.

articleTitle: Characteristics analyses of pedestrian walking speed at transfer hubs
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: The walking speed of pedestrians at a transfer hub is related to individual characteristics, facilities for pedestrians, and environmental conditions etc. Facilities include pavements, stairs and escalators. Individual characteristics involve gender, age, size of group pedestrian and purposes.

articleTitle: Analysis on layout design method of bus stop for urban-rural integrations
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: This paper analyzes the design of public transit infrastructure facilities for integration, with bus stops of urban and rural areas as research objects. Then the design method of urban ones is consulted to give improving advice for the existing urban and rural bus stops. Finally, some suggestions of layout design of bus stops for urban rural integration are proposed in a case study.

articleTitle: Simulative analysis of cyclist's head impact point in vehicle-electric bicycle rear-end crashes
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: In order to study the characteristics of cyclist head impact point in vehicle-electric bicycle rear-end crashes, we build the models of cyclist, electric-bicycle and vehicle based on PC-Crash, in which three types of vehicle, namely compact car, SUV and sports car are selected, and the impact point between vehicle and electric-bicycle is located in the middle of the bumper and the collision angles are 0°, 30° and 60°, respectively. Major analysis is based on the governing factors such as vehicle types, collision angels and collision speeds. The results indicate that the hood height is a significant factor affecting the head impact point on the vehicle, i.e. the head impact point becomes closer to the front of the vehicle with the hood height increasing. In addition, the head impact point on the vehicle in car to electric-bicycle rear-end crashes is also highly dependent on the collision angle and speed, namely, the impact points is located in the lower middle of the windshield with a larger collision angle at higher collision speeds.

articleTitle: Collision risk related to independent approaches of parallel runways
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Due to continuous increase of flight, some domestic airports apply wide-distance parallel runways. For security reasons, the width is higher than standard value of independent parallel approach, which resulting in substantial increase in construction. This study focuses on the collision risk related to independent parallel approaches and the rang of collision risk can be judged acceptable. Based on the study of risk assessment index, we provide new index which suitable for independent parallel approaches. Based on the ICAO, we provide a range of safety level for the new index. A risk model is developed for determination of the collision risk value between aircraft conducting independent parallel approaches under Instrument Meteorological. This study focus on key link of process, not only provide ways to reduce the risk of collision, but also give some advises for planning and construction of airports. At present, the domestic and foreign research parallel runways effective operation mode has achieved some staged progress, but lack for independent parallel instrument approach operating modes security index and target security levels. articleTitle: Types and characteristics analysis of integrated transportation corridors
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Integrated transportation corridor classification is one of the basic elements of the integrated transportation theory. In this paper, the existing problems of integrated transportation corridors classification are first analyzed. The existed corridor types and characteristics are summarized in terms of spatial level, transportation modes, and service objects, and relevant content has been added and improved. Then, transportation corridor types based on service features and functional characteristics are proposed, and characteristics analysis is also conducted. The results indicate that the classification based on service features and functional characteristics can not only reflect the supply and demand of corridors, but directly show the function of corridors. Finally, the proposed corridor classifications are analyzed with a case.

articleTitle: Prediction of intergraded transportation demand based on development strategy
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: The traffic and transportation system is in a reciprocity relationship with the society and economic development. The transportation demand increases not exactly according to the history trend in the background of huge changed development strategy, the main carriers of which are three including gross product, government revenue and population. The multiple nonlinear prediction model is established with the three variables and the parameters are demarcated. The tests in the four types of transportation volume of history data show the average relative error is within 10%, thus the model has good accuracy. At last, the transportation demand is predicted in the case of some area where the development strategy is adjusted materially.

articleTitle: Safety message transmitting method for vehicle infrastructure integration
publicationTitle: 6th Advanced Forum on Transportation of China (AFTC 2010)
abstract: Summary form only given. Recent years, as one of the application scenario of MANETs, the vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) attracted great interest in the field of intelligent transportation systems (ITS). There are some properties in VANET which make it different from MANET, for example high speeds vehicles result in frequent and fast changes in the network topologies, network topologies and the node movements are constrained by physical factors as vehicles can only move along road ways. With the help of VANETs, many kinds of safety and traffic efficiency related applications can be realized, such as cooperative collision avoiding: the high speed of wireless communication let drivers have enough time to stop the vehicle before crashes happening; dynamic traffic assignment: the traffic conditions can be transmitted to the drivers directly with wireless data communication. These applications, particularly safety applications, require a high availability of the communication system and low delivery latency for data packets.
